correctness.rationale: The actual embedded verify.py was run successfully. It exhaustively enumerates orbit faces for each m=2..6 using strict chord crossing and union-find acyclicity, verifies every maximal-face dimension, all matched incidence pairs and acyclicity of the reversed Hasse graph by exact topological sort; only a vertex and top-dimensional critical cells remain, proving the stated wedges by Forman. Separate all-subset enumeration confirms face counts for m<=5. Numeric logs alone are not the proof; the full source and finite loop bounds specify the exhaustive mathematical argument.

value.rationale: The chord-forest complex is natural from the classical enumeration of noncrossing forests. Its central rotation is a canonical symmetry, with geometric fixed simplices invisible to vertexwise fixed counts. The complete first five nontrivial even polygon sizes exhibit a systematically increasing sequence of integral sphere wedges, culminating in 524 five-spheres, and supply rigorous finite benchmarks for potential type-B symmetry formulas. This is a motivated complete finite classification, not a claimed general theorem.
